title: Training for Victory in the War of Faith
description: This week, Pastor Chris Zehner preaches about the life-changing power of God's presence in our lives, reminding us that we are essential to the world because we are the answer to the world's deep-seated desires for joy, strength, and hope. Through Psalm 144, Pastor Chris reveals how God trains us for the war of faith, equipping us with the armor of love, kindness, and deliverance to overcome every attack and emerge victorious. Join us as we discover how to tap into God's supernatural strength and encouragement, and live the life we were meant to live.
